 Adams woman arrested for over $12,000 in alleged SNAP fraud 
 By 7 News Staff Published : Nov. 4, 2026 at 10:53 AM EST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google TOWN OF ADAMS, New York (WWNY) - An Adams woman was arrested Wednesday on four felony charges alleging she received SNAP benefits she was not entitled to, according to an arrest report and felony complaints in Watertown City Court.
 Nicole Brown, 35, of Adams, was charged with first-degree offering a false instrument for filing, a Class E felony; third-degree grand larceny, a Class D felony; third-degree welfare fraud, a Class D felony; and misuse of food stamps, a Class D felony, according to the arrest report from the Watertown City Police Department.
 Arrest
 Brown was arrested at 7:50 a.m. Wednesday at 751 Waterman Drive in Watertown. The report says Brown turned herself in, was processed, and was held pending arraignment in Watertown City Court at 9 a.m. Wednesday.
 Allegations in the complaints
 The grand larceny and misuse of food stamps complaints allege that from Nov. 1, 2022, through Oct. 31, 2024, Brown obtained $12,037 in SNAP benefits from the Jefferson County Department of Social Services under false pretenses. The complaints allege she failed to tell the department required information about her income and gave false information about her income on an application and two periodic reports.
 The complaint for misuse of food stamps alleges Brown was not an eligible recipient and knowingly acquired the benefits by not reporting her household income and by submitting the application and reports knowing they contained false information.
 The complaint for offering a false instrument for filing alleges that Brown submitted the application and periodic reports with intent to fraudulently receive benefits and incorrectly reported her income. It lists the amount received as $12,037.
 The complaint for third-degree welfare fraud alleges Brown submitted the same application and reports knowing they omitted information about her income. It lists the amount received as $9,517.
